protocol.controls: Four exact final-year uniform-profile replays. Candidate climates start from the settled paired baseline final state.
protocol.forcing: Native cached monthly local mixing ratio at each boundary cell/actual pressure, same nominal event pulse and safe local saturation cap. Dry 150hPa lid retained. No horizontal/vertical dry-flow changes.
protocol.dose: local uses its own native-pattern gross input; local_matched normalizes to the original actual monthly gross incoming vapor. Actual humidity means/variance and cap clipping need not match.
protocol.selection: Fixed regional input sensitivity with bulk and lower-interface cloud rules; no parameter fit or best-seed selection. Reused synthetic weather and different climatology periods are not independent climate validation.

california.note: Native monthly local mixing ratios with original nominal event pulse. Matched variant holds actual monthly gross incoming vapor fixed. Caps and normalization can change actual humidity means/variance. Land/marine boundary-cell categories do not identify outside-domain ancestry or which edge supplies rain.
